explanation: Mathlib defines only `HahnSeries.truncLT`, with `coeff_truncLT`, in RingTheory/HahnSeries/Basic.lean. It has no `truncGT` definition and no coefficient lemma for one. The `truncGT` matches under Algebra/Homology and CategoryTheory are unrelated (`truncGE`, `truncLE` for complexes and t-structures). `HahnEmbedding.lean` has no match for `truncGT`, `truncGE` or `truncLE`. `coeff_truncLT` is the dual statement, with `i < c` in place of `c < i`, so it cannot be instantiated to give this result.
